analysis.rationale: Record revenue and profit, strong double-digit growth, and improved margins indicate robust financial health. The company also highlighted premiumisation and EV growth, supporting a positive outlook.
analysis.summary: Hero MotoCorp reported record revenue of ₹46,830 crore and PAT of ₹5,268 crore for FY2025-26, with 14.9% revenue growth and 14.3% PAT growth YoY.
